headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs SPY
summary: As of August 19, 2026, the portfolio is demonstrating a strong performance with an average return of 24.35%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark return of 13.50%. This results in an average alpha of 10.85%, indicating that the portfolio is not only gaining in value but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has achieved an impressive return of 45.77%, contributing positively to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has a return of 11.20%, which still aligns with the benchmark but highlights the disparity in performance among the portfolios. This outperformance is particularly relevant during times of market stress or uncertainty, as it reflects the portfolio's resilience compared to broader market trends. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
